contract_clarification: The initial implementation incorrectly treated the reconstructed physical residual as a universal pass threshold for truncated bases. This was corrected before qualification: the physical residual remains reported, is a strict check only for full-basis equivalence, and is diagnostic-only for truncated bases. No numerical threshold was raised.

input_contract.modal_mode_count: required positive integer; no implicit truncation count
input_contract.modal_extraction_method: existing WP04 extraction method, default eigsh
input_contract.frequency_input: existing frequencies_hz/frequency range contract; finite and non-negative
input_contract.explicit_excitation_api: ExcitationChannelSet for one frequency or a frequency_hz-to-ExcitationChannelSet mapping for a sweep; exact frequency match required
input_contract.legacy_excitation: WP03 legacy adapter; unchanged historical real load semantics

equations.reduced_rhs: Fr = Phi.T * Fhat; WP03 spatial distributions are real and phasors retain real/imaginary parts
equations.physical_reconstruction: U = expand(Phi * Q) using the exact prepared DOF reduction
equations.operators: use explicitly projected Mr and Kr; do not replace them by I or diag(eigenvalues)

rayleigh.definition: C = alpha*M + beta*K; Cr = Phi.T*C*Phi = alpha*Mr + beta*Kr
rayleigh.existing_two_target_calibration: uses rayleigh_damping_definition and remains physical Rayleigh damping

prescribed_modal.parameters: modal_damping_ratios, one finite non-negative ratio per retained mode
prescribed_modal.operator: reuse WP04 invariant cluster operator; Cr is a reduced model, not a full physical C
prescribed_modal.reactions: UNAVAILABLE; do not synthesize a physical C matrix

damping.rayleigh_reactions: NOT_COMPUTED by WP05; reaction recovery is not implied by the reduced response

numerical_policy.scaled_impedance: S*Zr*S where S=diag(1/sqrt(diag(Kr))); all diagonal entries must be positive
numerical_policy.conditioning_indicator: min(rcond, singular_floor); singular_floor prevents a scalar impedance near zero from appearing well-conditioned
numerical_policy.singular_or_quasi_singular_action: fail closed when conditioning indicator <= 1e-12; preserve a warning diagnostic when <= 1e-8
numerical_policy.frequency_and_phasor_match: exact finite Hz values; no implicit interpolation
numerical_policy.zero_rhs: solve the same impedance contract; zero force does not bypass singularity checks

residuals_and_error.physical_residual: computed on free physical equations only when a full physical damping operator exists; strict 1e-8 check applies only for a full basis
residuals_and_error.truncated_basis_physical_residual: reported as a diagnostic of omitted equation content; no general threshold is a truncation-error estimate
residuals_and_error.prescribed_modal_physical_residual: UNAVAILABLE because no complete physical C exists
residuals_and_error.truncation_error: NOT_KNOWN_EXACTLY; reduced residual and modal participation are not physical truncation-error estimates

result_availability.complex_full_response: AVAILABLE unless response_probes selects a partial output
result_availability.complex_modal_coordinates: AVAILABLE and retained per requested frequency
result_availability.physical_free_residual: AVAILABLE for Rayleigh damping; UNAVAILABLE for prescribed modal damping
result_availability.physical_reactions: NOT_COMPUTED for Rayleigh; UNAVAILABLE for prescribed modal damping

memory_policy.response_probes: optional list of active {node,dof} outputs; retain only selected response entries after solving each frequency
memory_policy.frequency_sweep: process one frequency at a time; do not build an N_DOF by N_FREQUENCY dense block
memory_policy.reduced_operators: dense mode_count by mode_count operators inherited from WP04
